name: WhatsMyName
summary: Username enumeration across ~700 sites using the WhatsMyName dataset (https://github.com/WebBreacher/WhatsMyName, CC-BY-SA-4.0). Desktop only.
description:
Username enumeration: given a handle, which of the roughly 700 sites in the WhatsMyName dataset have an account under that name. A site counts as a hit by WhatsMyName's own rule: its response status equals the dataset's `e_code` and, where the entry gives an `e_string`, that text appears in the body.

**Who sees it:** every site in the dataset, asked directly from the analyst's machine for its profile URL with the handle in it. Roughly 700 sites see the handle, and a site whose answer looked like a hit may also see one or two random control accounts. jsDelivr serves the site list and does not see the handle. Requests carry no cookies or credentials, so they see what a logged-out visitor sees.

**Read results with care:**
- An apparent hit is counted as blocked, not added, when the body shows a WAF or challenge page, or when the site also finds a random account of the same length and character classes. Blocked is counted apart from misses: the site gave no trustworthy answer, which is not a clean miss.
- Redirects are not followed, so a redirect to a login page reads as no account. A site whose request fails counts as no result.
- For an email address the handle is the local part: often a real username, but not necessarily the one its owner uses elsewhere.

**Data and licences:** the list is fetched at run time from the dataset's `main` branch, which jsDelivr may cache for about 12 hours, so two runs at different times can check different sets of sites. The anti-bot signatures are drawn from sherlock's WAFHitMsgs and the official WhatsMyName checker's BLOCKING_SIGNALS.

**Source:** https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-whatsmyname (Apache-2.0)

plugins.name: WhatsMyName Account Search
plugins.description: Checks whether each selected handle is registered on ~700 sites from the WhatsMyName dataset. Takes Handle, Account, Social Account or Email Address nodes (an email address uses its local part). Creates a Handle node (unless the seed is one), linked "uses handle" from the seed, and one Account per site where the handle was found (username, platform, profile_url), linked "same handle" from the Handle; likely false positives are counted as blocked and not added. Desktop only.

web_probe.purpose: Check each WhatsMyName site for a profile under the handle.
